title: Timing and Counting
lead: Covers lecture 07 and exercise 5: why timers/counters, how an 8-bit and a 16-bit timer work, elapsed-time and initial-value formulas, the registers TCCRnB, TCNTn, TIFRn (write-one-to-clear) and TIMSKn, systems 10 to 14 (count events, 200 ms blinker, polling and interrupts), and the reaction timer exercise with random numbers. Built from the slides and peer notes pages 39 to 40.
